THE SPLIT PLATE / RECIPE

Zero-Calorie Shaved Ice Hack

Two ingredients, no machine: blend plain ice into snow, pack it into a cup, and finish with a zero-calorie-labeled water enhancer. A cold, sweet, occasional hot-day treat — not fruit, and not a nutritional stand-in for it.

YIELD1 serving
TOTAL TIME5 min
COOK METHODSee method
EST. / SERVING~0 cal | ~0g protein
KEY TO SUCCESS: Blend plain ice — water only — until it becomes a fine, fluffy snow.

Ingredients

Ingredients

  • Plain ice cubes (enough to fill your blender part-way; makes about one packed cup of snow)
  • Zero-calorie-labeled liquid water enhancer, to taste (MiO Fruit Punch used on camera)
  • Optional: a second zero-calorie-labeled water enhancer flavor for a two-color cup (cosmetic only)

It's hot, you want something cold and sweet, and you don't want the sugar or calories of a syrup snow cone. An occasional treat — not a fruit serving.

Method

  1. 1.BLEND ICE TO SNOW. Blend plain ice cubes until they break down into a fine, fluffy snow. Scoop the snow into a cup and press it level.
  2. 2.CHECK THE LABEL. Reach for a liquid water enhancer whose package is labeled zero calories — MiO Fruit Punch on camera. 'Zero' is per the printed serving and subject to label rounding; it is not fruit.
  3. 3.ADD THE FLAVOR. Squeeze the water enhancer over the packed snow just before eating so it stays fluffy instead of melting into slush.
  4. 4.TWO COLORS + SERVE. For fun, add a second enhancer flavor on the other half for a two-color cup — the color is food dye, not fruit. Eat immediately while it's cold.

Keys to success

  • Pack the snow into the cup and level it before flavoring.
  • Add the water enhancer right before eating so the snow doesn't melt into slush.

If something fails

The snow melted into slush: Flavor it right before eating, not ahead of time. The liquid enhancer speeds melting once it's on.

Ice came out chunky, not snowy: Blend longer or in smaller batches, or use a dedicated snow-cone shaver. You want a fine, fluffy texture.

Flavor is watery or weak: Add a little more enhancer to taste. Different brands and flavors vary in concentration.

Storage and reheating

Store: Make and eat fresh. Blended snow melts quickly and does not store.

Reheat: N/A — it's a cold treat. Re-blend fresh ice if it melts.

Lasts: Minutes. Serve immediately.

Estimated nutrition

~0 cal | ~0g protein.

Plain ice is water and contributes no calories. The flavor comes from a liquid water enhancer whose package is labeled zero calories — but that 'zero' is per the printed serving and is subject to standard label-rounding rules, so it is not a literal, unlimited zero. The bright color is food dye in the enhancer, not fruit. This is an occasional cold, sweet treat and is NOT fruit or a nutritional substitute for fruit. Verify the current enhancer label before publishing any calorie claim.
